meaning:
net, fishing net
Also means: mikh.mo.ret (מִכְמֹ֫רֶת "net" H4365B)

elsewhere.note: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.
He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net, and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.
